title: Summarize debug console results and replay progress
changes: Show bounded operation-specific summaries, current replay-frame observations and confirmed selections while preventing stale result details from being attributed to failed or unrelated commands.
Wrap recent result lines and expose them in the scrollable command context at narrow window sizes; preserve complete copyable JSON and English/Italian messages.
validation: Windows GNU runtime and test builds passed; Wine ran 36 input-config tests, 3 menu tests, 5 observation tests and an action-contract matrix comparing console and CLI parameters across supported families.

At a verified 480x360 Wine client, inspection summary and scrollable context matched the copied JSON with guest state unchanged. A reused 102-frame replay showed intermediate 11/102 and 52/102 before reaching 102/102; the worker simultaneously reported 63/102 and 84/102. Exact-ID and retry procedure evidence remains in the existing records.
limitations: The UI shows the latest sampled progress, which can lag the worker; no real-time bound is claimed. Simulated Wine/Xvfb input and selected operation results only; native Windows/Linux and physical inputs remain unverified.
